name: Zechariah
tagline: Visions of hope for the returned exiles
author: Zechariah. Some scholars see a different author for the later chapters.
setting: Returned exiles are encouraged to finish the temple.
theme: God will cleanse his people and send a humble king.

outline.label: The horns and the measuring line
The pierced one and the cleansing fountain

christInBook: Zechariah 9:9, the king who comes humble and riding on a donkey, is fulfilled at the triumphal entry. The pierced one (12:10), the shepherd who is struck (13:7), and the fountain for sin (13:1) all point to Christ.
howToRead: Zechariah is full of visions and symbols. Read the visions in chapters 1 to 6 as encouragement for builders, and chapters 9 to 14 as oracles about the coming king.
